summary:
• Solid charcoal and forest-green colors with VEXO lime controls.
• Smart Experience is after Settings in the bottom navigation.
• Cloud MindRadio music requests and refinements, with consent and local fallback.
• Live FairPlay listening rooms, fair requests, host controls and reconnect support.
• Private memories, playlist recovery, anti-repeat and discovery tools.
• AI: five requests per device/day; shared service quotas apply. Rooms: eight listeners, two hours.
• Each phone streams independently; shared playback timing can vary.
• Existing app data is preserved. Licensed lyric search, full audio metadata and authorized online downloads remain dependencies.
